name: consensus handles missing values and stable ties
rates and rejection use strict thresholds and evidence
test:
labels = [['a','a','b'], ['a','a','b'], ['b','b','a'], [None,None,'a']]
rates = agreement_rates(labels, min_labels=2)
assert rates[0] == rates[1] == 1.0 and rates[2] == 0.0
assert select_rejected_annotators(labels, threshold=0.1, min_labels=2, max_removed_fraction=0.5, min_remaining=1) == [2]

name: masking copies instead of mutating
test:
labels = [['a', 'b'], ['c', None]]
masked = mask_annotators(labels, [1])
assert masked == [['a', None], ['c', None]]
assert labels == [['a', 'b'], ['c', None]]
